cost_evidence: CONSERVATIVE_AUTHORED_ENVELOPES_NOT_MODEL_BILLS. Actual fixed deterministic service production and independent checking execute. No paid frontier-model inference is called. Setup includes all discovery, authored construction, rejected fixtures, initial prequalification and integration; per-attempt includes production/replay, verification, corrections, failed/unpaid work, storage, delivery, support, maintenance; acquisition charged on every exposed bid including losses. CPU runtime is not human task time. No human-review hour is inserted. Resource billing unavailable.
human_evidence: Authored corresponding complete-service workload scenarios, not measured human times or observed selling prices. Loaded hourly values are bounded scenario proxies; ranges 0.5x–2x remain sensitivity inputs. No program runtime is converted into human effort. First-order complete work is0.65h for12-invoice reconciliation and10-metric variance,0.80h for8-requirement source matrix; preparation charged once/customer; repeats deduct0.10h onboarding. These small-fixture time hypotheses avoid applying multi-hour workloads to tiny delivered artifacts. Competent complete human delivery includes verification, correction, support and tools.
assumptions: All demand, budgets, arrival, switching, urgency, retention, competitor quality, rate limits, taxes and provider protection are disclosed conditional scenarios, not observed market estimates.
Churn persists with active=False; bounded independent channel reacquisition may restore a churned customer after an actual settled simulated order, with no repeated provider onboarding.
Buyer private value/budget and deterministic draws are not passed to seller pricing; seller uses public segment priors and its own transactional history only.

Turnaround2h/24h/48h are explicitly authored SLA waiting times, never labor hours. Ordinary segment values 2h complete delivery versus competent 24h rival and 48h human; same scoped outcome and obligations. Price war removes most latency differentiation. Trust ranges overlap; actual checker evidence is required for our deliveries.
Native principal-plus-fee tail reserves remain restricted throughout horizon; seed capital may back reserves. Earned delivery funding and seed-independent reserve replacement are separate metrics.

Tax is a conditional 20% positive-profit provision paid in the simulation; sales-tax collection/remittance assumed zero for nonjurisdictional synthetic workload. No tax compliance or actual transaction is asserted.

Bundles are optional grouped three-service orders with total willingness-to-pay and component identities; a bundle replaces its component sale opportunities, never adds duplicate revenue. Context reuse reduces one-time provider onboarding across services but does not grant data access.
